scope: Proposition 5.7 (Marked recurrence at an arbitrary hook parameter) of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n = ab ≥ 4, where a, b ≥ 2 are powers of two and | log2 a − log2 b| ≤ 1. Arrange the positions as a rows of length b, so that Bn = CR, where R consists of the a independent row sweeps Bb and C consists of the b independent column sweeps Ba. Let p ≥ 2 be real and let q ≥ 1 be any integer. For every λ ⊢ n with positive moment and every q-hook subpartition ω ⊆ λ, put t = n − |ω|. Then En(λ; p) + jn(t) ≤ max A    X g ( Emg (ξg; p) + jmg (lg) ) − X g Hηg − Hω ! +    + C h t + (a + b)(q2 + n1/4 ) log(n + 1) i . (33) Here g ranges over all rows and columns, and mg = b on a row and mg = a on a column. The set A consists of choices satisfying 0 ≤ lg ≤ mg, X g row lg = X g column lg = t, ξg ⊢ mg, Emg (ξg; p) > −∞, ηg ⊆ ξg, |ηg| = mg − lg, (ηg)q+1 ≤ q. The set A is nonempty when the parent moment is positive. The constant C is absolute, independent of p, q, a, b, λ, ω.
